bootstrap.unit: Paired whole eight-draw prompt groups, independently stratified by domain and level.

details.authorization: User approved small three-model ablation where supported; two supported API-contract candidates admitted, DeepSeek excluded because temperature ignored with thinking.
details.effective_sampler_note: Provider contracts support requested controls and Azure accepted all four preflights. Responses do not expose effective temperature; deployment internals cannot be independently audited.
details.paired_collection: Both temperatures run concurrently within each model, with identical request order and same non-temperature settings.

definitions.accuracy: Correct answers / all retained sampled answers.
definitions.collision: Colliding correct pairs / correct pairs, pooled within each domain-level cell.
definitions.distinct8: Mean number of distinct correct canonical keys per eight draws; zero-correct prompts contribute zero.
definitions.macro: Equal mean of every included cell; any undefined member makes that macro metric undefined.
definitions.normalized_secondary: Previously frozen formatting-only normalizer applied to source-bound audited strict receipts.
definitions.uniform_collision: Correct-pair-weighted uniform collision over certified finite canonical modes; undefined for Countdown.

limitations: Small exploratory follow-up: eight prompts per cell.
API acceptance is not independent observation of the internal sampling actuator.
Eligibility can differ across temperatures; collision conditions on correct answers.
Original full model cohorts and their provider defaults are not replaced.
Level populations differ and do not establish monotonically greater model difficulty.
Static inference concentration does not identify a training or parameter-scale cause.
